description: NOAA Climate Prediction Center Oceanic Nino Index (ONI): 3-month running anomaly of sea surface temperature in the Nino 3.4 region, by season, plus a label (El Nino at +0.5 or higher, La Nina at -0.5 or lower, otherwise neutral). Official NOAA CPC threshold; the file is updated monthly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_noaa_enso_elnino_la_nina
title: Energy Noaa Enso Elnino La Nina
